_doc: Event quest enemies our master lacks (Events Part 1, Task 2b, 6 Nov 2026): displayId -> name, model (new = every mandatory animation complete in the JP 4.3.1 data with the versioned copy tables; missing = textures or animations still not found, never replaced by another enemy), approved (the user saw the rendered animations). make_jp_enemies.py builds only the approved ones (--event-all: every one, for renders and deep_donors.py). review: user decision on the rendered sheets. Events Part 2 (07-11-2026): 36 models + 96 Circus Clown approved on the rendered review (17 of the pilot, 19 of the gem quests); partial = accepted with missing pieces; std_dead = standard smoke dead. 185 Enraged Elk has no own model and no entry: its event rows show the served story model 184 (server/make-event-enemies.js DISPLAY_AS, user decision 07-11).
